name: Health record

elements.name: Save
elements.shows: Save · N pigs
elements.rule: Waits until a condition is chosen and at least one row would change; N = pigs that would change (the ticked pigs while it waits). No line is drawn above it: a tap while it waits marks Conditions "Required" and scrolls to it. Writes one finding per pig and name, day 1, recorded 12 Sep 2026 by G. Hansen, plus one "Health recorded" log entry. A condition the pig already has is skipped and keeps its original start date. Returns to the walk list.

rules: One searchable disease/symptom catalogue for one or many pigs.
issues: Default Care "No action needed" makes the quickest path (choose Fever, Save) record a fever as a non-alert (filed To confirm).
The catalogue needs three levels (tab, door, item) for a gloved worker.

notes.purpose: Search or browse the disease and symptom catalogue and tick one or more.

elements.name: Catalogue
elements.shows: Conditions › Diseases or Symptoms › category › items, one level at a time

states.shows: Diseases and Symptoms, each with "N selected" once something below is ticked

The level as the title (Diseases; Respiratory diseases), the ✕ at the top left (closes the whole picker, keeps the ticks), the footer Back goes up one level (at Conditions it leaves); no "‹ Parent", no breadcrumb (owner ruling B, 2026-10-16)

Searches the whole catalogue from any level ("Search all options"); matches name and aliases (PRRS, pig flu); every result names its category (Coughing · Respiratory system); Clear empties it; "Add “name”" only when nothing matches
Asks for a category; removable with an x; kept for the session

elements.logic: Item row shows how many selected pigs already carry it ("Already on 1 selected"). The drawer keeps one height from open to close (its tallest level, up to the cap).

elements.name: Done
elements.shows: Done · N
elements.rule: Done · N applies the ticks to the Conditions field and closes. Back goes up one level; at Conditions it closes without applying, and so does the ✕ from any level; ticks wait for the next open (the scrim does the same). Done waits while nothing is ticked and nothing was applied.

elements.rule: Banner notice: a condition that follows from the commit, stated before the action it governs (Banner, When); not danger (nothing is destroyed) and not correction (nothing is reviewed).
